semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides factory automation components and solutions, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: A&T (Changzhou) Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., operating under the brand Aiante Technology, specializes in the distribution of factory automation components and solutions. They serve a wide range of industries, including semiconductors, by offering a comprehensive product range that supports diverse and high-frequency procurement needs.

regional_presence.China: The company has manufacturing bases and warehousing centers in Changzhou, Harbin, Tianjin, and Dongguan, with service centers in over 30 cities including Shanghai, Beijing, Suzhou, Shenzhen, and Chengdu.
